key: Hm... "A Brief Review of Energy". Does that sound interesting?
en: Hm... "A Brief Review of Energy". Does that sound interesting?
ja: うーん……「エネルギー概論」。面白そうかな?

key: "Energy exists in many forms, but it is seldom adequately appreciated.
en: "Energy exists in many forms, but it is seldom adequately appreciated.
ja: 「エネルギーには多くの形があるが、十分に理解されていることは少ない。

key: One form of energy that is often neglected is that that exists not as power or potential, but the very spirit of being.
en: One form of energy that is often neglected is that that exists not as power or potential, but the very spirit of being.
ja: しばしば見過ごされがちなエネルギーの一形態が、力や潜在力としてではなく、存在そのものの精神として現れるものである。

key: When you form a fist and strike, you are transferring energy.
en: When you form a fist and strike, you are transferring energy.
ja: こぶしを握って打ち込むとき、あなたはエネルギーを伝えている。

key: The energy transfers through your body.
en: The energy transfers through your body.
ja: そのエネルギーは、あなたの体を通って伝わっていく。

key: If you strike a target, it transfers into the target, damaging it.
en: If you strike a target, it transfers into the target, damaging it.
ja: 対象を打てば、それは対象へと伝わり、ダメージを与える。

key: This is commonly understood.
en: This is commonly understood.
ja: これは一般的に理解されていることだ。

key: But consider the transfer of energy if you do not strike a target. What happens to it?
en: But consider the transfer of energy if you do not strike a target. What happens to it?
ja: では、対象を打たなかった場合のエネルギーの伝達について考えてみよう。それはどこへ行くのか?

key: In answer, the energy still transfers even if no target is struck.
en: In answer, the energy still transfers even if no target is struck.
ja: 答えを言えば、対象を打たなかったとしても、エネルギーはやはり伝わる。

key: The very action of punching itself carries a force which is understood universally.
en: The very action of punching itself carries a force which is understood universally.
ja: 拳を突き出すという行為そのものが、普遍的に理解される力を帯びているのだ。

key: Even if you do not punch someone so much as punch at them, some part of them will still feel the impact of the punch's energy.
en: Even if you do not punch someone so much as punch at them, some part of them will still feel the impact of the punch's energy.
ja: たとえ誰かを実際に殴らず、その方向へ突き出すだけであっても、相手のどこかは、その拳のエネルギーの衝撃を感じ取るだろう。

key: It may not manifest as physical pain or damage, but the energy will continue to flow, as always it does."
en: It may not manifest as physical pain or damage, but the energy will continue to flow, as always it does."
ja: それは肉体的な痛みやダメージとして現れないかもしれないが、エネルギーは常にそうであるように、流れ続けるのだ」

key: Okay, I need to get better at this: "How to Meditate".
en: Okay, I need to get better at this: "How to Meditate".
ja: よし、これはもっと上達しないと、「めい想のやり方」。

key: Do you wanna be my study buddy?
en: Do you wanna be my study buddy?
ja: 一緒に勉強する相手になってくれない?

key: "Meditation is simply the art of clearing your head of thoughts.
en: "Meditation is simply the art of clearing your head of thoughts.
ja: 「めい想とは、単に頭の中から思考を取り除く技術である。

key: Although this sounds simple, it can be very difficult for the unpracticed.
en: Although this sounds simple, it can be very difficult for the unpracticed.
ja: 単純に聞こえるかもしれないが、慣れていない者にとっては非常に難しいことがある。

key: To begin, play calming music, or find a quiet place, or place with some other natural rhythm (for instance, the rhythm of waves dancing on the beach).
en: To begin, play calming music, or find a quiet place, or place with some other natural rhythm (for instance, the rhythm of waves dancing on the beach).
ja: まずは、落ち着く音楽をかけるか、静かな場所、あるいは何か自然なリズムのある場所(たとえば、波が浜辺で踊るリズムなど)を見つけよう。

key: Find a comfortable seated position, and close your eyes.
en: Find a comfortable seated position, and close your eyes.
ja: 座って心地よい姿勢を見つけ、目を閉じる。

key: Then simply think about nothing.
en: Then simply think about nothing.
ja: それから、ただ何も考えないようにする。

key: When you first try this, you will quickly realize how difficult it is for you to stop thinking.
en: When you first try this, you will quickly realize how difficult it is for you to stop thinking.
ja: 初めて試すと、思考を止めることがいかに難しいか、すぐに気づくだろう。

key: Thoughts will drift in and out despite your efforts. This is normal.
en: Thoughts will drift in and out despite your efforts.  This is normal.
ja: 努力にもかかわらず、思考は出たり入ったりするものだ。これは正常なことである。

key: But each time you find yourself thinking again, force yourself to return to a blank slate.
en: But each time you find yourself thinking again, force yourself to return to a blank slate.
ja: しかし、自分がまた考え始めていると気づくたびに、意識してまっさらな状態に戻すようにしよう。

key: For beginners, it is also sometimes helpful to instead think only about the rhythm of one's breath.
en: For beginners, it is also sometimes helpful to instead think only about the rhythm of one's breath.
ja: 初心者にとっては、代わりに自分の呼吸のリズムだけを考えるのも助けになることがある。

key: Continue in this way to practice clearing your head and keeping it free of distraction for as long as you wish to meditate."
en: Continue in this way to practice clearing your head and keeping it free of distraction for as long as you wish to meditate."
ja: このようにして、めい想したい間、頭を空にして雑念のない状態を保つ練習を続けよう」

key: There's a guy who's come here recently.
en: There's a guy who's come here recently.
ja: 最近ここに来た男がいるんだ。

key: Pretty odd fellow.
en: Pretty odd fellow.
ja: なかなか変わった奴でね。

key: He's quiet and keeps to himself, but really stands out.
en: He's quiet and keeps to himself, but really stands out.
ja: 静かで一人でいることが多いけど、それでもすごく目立つんだ。

key: I know he attends every lecture, but I've never seen him fight.
en: I know he attends every lecture, but I've never seen him fight.
ja: あの人、講義には毎回出てるけど、戦ってるところは一度も見たことないな。

key: I think he went to train at the volcano?
en: I think he went to train at the volcano?
ja: 火山で修行してるって聞いたけど?

key: Victoria's been gone for a while.
en: Victoria's been gone for a while.
ja: ヴィクトリア、しばらく姿を見ないね。

key: What's with her?
en: What's with her?
ja: どうしたんだろう?

key: ...Unless it's something to do with him. Hm~
en: ...Unless it's something to do with him. Hm~
ja: ……もしかして、あの人と関係あるのかな。ふーん〜

key: Kiki gave her life to save all of us?
en: Kiki gave her life to save all of us?
ja: キキ先生は、わたしたち全員を救うために命をかけてくれたの?

key: ...Let's make good use of our time and work hard.
en: ...Let's make good use of our time and work hard.
ja: ……この時間を大切に使って、頑張ろう。

key: Have you met Cal?
en: Have you met Cal?
ja: キャルには会った?

key: He's kinda weird, but kinda cool.
en: He's kinda weird, but kinda cool.
ja: ちょっと変わってるけど、なんかカッコいいんだよね。

key: And by that I mean, kinda hot.
en: And by that I mean, kinda hot.
ja: つまり、まあまあイケてるってこと。

key: Oh, don't tell Victoria I said that!
en: Oh, don't tell Victoria I said that!
ja: あ、今の、ヴィクトリアには言わないでよ!

key: It feels really lonely here now...
en: It feels really lonely here now...
ja: 今、ここが本当に寂しく感じる……

key: This is the main lecture hall, but we do a lot of classes outside, too. By the water, or on Pyrous Mountain, or in the Training Grounds.
en: This is the main lecture hall, but we do a lot of classes outside, too. By the water, or on Pyrous Mountain, or in the Training Grounds.
ja: ここがメインの講堂だけど、外でも授業をたくさんやるんだよ。水辺とか、パイロス山とか、修練場とかで。

key: It's like there's a field trip every day!
en: It's like there's a field trip every day!
ja: まるで毎日、遠足があるみたいだよね!

key: Is Kiki really gone?
en: Is Kiki really gone?
ja: キキ先生、本当にいなくなっちゃったの?

key: I mean, she can't be, right?
en: I mean, she can't be, right?
ja: だって、そんなはずないよね?

key: She'll come back with some super-zen-ish power, somehow!
en: She'll come back with some super-zen-ish power, somehow!
ja: きっとなんか、すごい禅パワーみたいなのを引っさげて戻ってくるよ!

key: Like, "One must transcend life in order to transcend death!"
en: Like, "One must transcend life in order to transcend death!"
ja: ほら、「死を超えるためには、まず生を超えねばならない」みたいなさ!

key: That sounds like something she'd say, right?!
en: That sounds like something she'd say, right?!
ja: いかにも先生が言いそうなことだよね?!

key: I mainly come here to hike, but I'd never miss a chance to listen to Kiki's lectures.
en: I mainly come here to hike, but I'd never miss a chance to listen to Kiki's lectures.
ja: 主にハイキングしに来てるだけなんだけど、キキ先生の講義だけは絶対に聞き逃さないんだ。

key: She's like a sage, that girl.
en: She's like a sage, that girl.
ja: あの人、まるで賢者だよね。

key: I didn't know her that well, but even I'm going to miss her.
en: I didn't know her that well, but even I'm going to miss her.
ja: そんなに知ってたわけじゃないけど、僕でも寂しく感じるよ。

key: This is Kiki's room. But she's out at the moment.
en: This is Kiki's room. But she's out at the moment.
ja: ここはキキ先生の部屋。でも今は外に出てるよ。

key: Oh, you're looking for her?
en: Oh, you're looking for her?
ja: あら、先生を探してるの?

key: Hm, well, she went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
en: Hm, well, she went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
ja: うーん、そうね、修練場で授業をしに行ってるよ。

key: You could probably try and catch her after the lecture.
en: You could probably try and catch her after the lecture.
ja: 講義が終わったあとなら、つかまえられるかも。

key: They're basically right out the front door; can't miss them.
en: They're basically right out the front door; can't miss them.
ja: だいたい正面玄関を出てすぐだから、見逃しようがないよ。

key: Kiki went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
en: Kiki went down to teach a class in the Training Grounds.
ja: キキ先生は修練場で授業をしに行ってるよ。

key: VICTORIA: Azurine Island is just a skip east of here.
en: VICTORIA: Azurine Island is just a skip east of here.
ja: ヴィクトリア: アズリン島は、ここからちょっと東に行ったところです。

key: You took a boat here, right?
en: You took a boat here, right?
ja: 船でここまで来ましたよね?

key: You should be able to reach it easily.
en: You should be able to reach it easily.
ja: 簡単に着けるはずです。

key: Whatever Team Meteor is up to, we've gotta stop them.
en: Whatever Team Meteor is up to, we've gotta stop them.
ja: チームメテオが何を企んでいるにせよ、止めなければ。

key: I'll keep everything steady here while you're out.
en: I'll keep everything steady here while you're out.
ja: あなたが出ている間、ここは私が落ち着けておきます。

key: Kiki is currently resting and has asked not to be disturbed.
en: Kiki is currently resting and has asked not to be disturbed.
ja: キキ先生は今休んでいて、邪魔しないでほしいとのことです。

key: Victoria just ran out of here though; didn't you see her?
en: Victoria just ran out of here though; didn't you see her?
ja: ヴィクトリアなら、たった今ここから飛び出していったよ、見なかった?

key: Kiki is currently amidst a lecture.
en: Kiki is currently amidst a lecture.
ja: キキ先生は今、講義の最中です。

key: I cannot allow you to enter this way.
en: I cannot allow you to enter this way.
ja: こちらからの入室はお断りしています。

key: Please enter through the front to attend her lecture.
en: Please enter through the front to attend her lecture.
ja: 講義に出席するなら、正面から入ってください。

key: VICTORIA: Deep breaths...
en: VICTORIA: Deep breaths...
ja: ヴィクトリア: 深呼吸……

key: \PN, I apologize to you on behalf of the academy.
en: \PN, I apologize to you on behalf of the academy.
ja: \PN、アカデミーを代表して、謝らせてください。

key: You've been wronged.
en: You've been wronged.
ja: あなたには、つらい思いをさせてしまいました。

key: I've never seen her fall apart so fast.
en: I've never seen her fall apart so fast.
ja: 先生があんなに一気に取り乱すところ、初めて見た。

key: All of this is... a lot of firsts.
en: All of this is... a lot of firsts.
ja: これは全部……初めてのことばかりだ。

key: ???: Victoria!
en: ???: Victoria!
ja: ???: ヴィクトリア!

key: There's news.
en: There's news.
ja: 知らせがあるの。

key: VICTORIA: I'm kind of over news right now.
en: VICTORIA: I'm kind of over news right now.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 今はもう、知らせとかいいです。

key: LETTIE: A couple of the students were hiking out at Azurine Island--
en: LETTIE: A couple of the students were hiking out at Azurine Island--
ja: レティ: 生徒の何人かが、アズリン島にハイキングに行ってたんだけど――

key: Apparently there's some suspicious folk over there?
en: Apparently there's some suspicious folk over there?
ja: そこに、なんか怪しい連中がいるらしいの?

key: Like full black suit and heavy machinery type suspicious?
en: Like full black suit and heavy machinery type suspicious?
ja: 全身黒スーツで、重機みたいなのを持ってる系の怪しさ?

key: VICTORIA: That'll be it.
en: VICTORIA: That'll be it.
ja: ヴィクトリア: それで決まりですね。

key: Thanks, Lettie.
en: Thanks, Lettie.
ja: ありがとう、レティ。

key: If anything else comes up, bring it to me.
en: If anything else comes up, bring it to me.
ja: 他に何かあったら、わたしのところに持ってきて。

key: Kiki is going to be resting for a while.
en: Kiki is going to be resting for a while.
ja: キキ先生はしばらく休むことになりました。

key: LETTIE: You got it, girlfriend!
en: LETTIE: You got it, girlfriend!
ja: レティ: 了解、任せて!

key: VICTORIA: I have to stay here.
en: VICTORIA: I have to stay here.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしはここに残らないと。

key: This school needs at least one person who can be honest and keep things moving.
en: This school needs at least one person who can be honest and keep things moving.
ja: この学校には、正直でいて物事を前に進められる人間が、少なくとも一人は必要です。

key: And, although I'm furious at her right now,
en: And, although I'm furious at her right now,
ja: それに、先生には今すごく腹が立ってるけど、

key: So does Kiki.
en: So does Kiki.
ja: それはキキ先生も同じ。

key: Can you check on Azurine Island?
en: Can you check on Azurine Island?
ja: アズリン島を見てきてもらえますか?

key: If anything else happens, or if that Machine turns up, I'll let you know as soon as I can.
en: If anything else happens, or if that Machine turns up, I'll let you know as soon as I can.
ja: 何かあったり、あの機械が見つかったりしたら、できるだけ早く知らせます。

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールでは誰も電話に出ないようだ……

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ! ジムに着いたのね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信機は大ホールに直結してるから、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでも相談の電話ができるのよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはそうと……

key: AME: Oh, you're coming in from Apophyll Academy?
en: AME: Oh, you're coming in from Apophyll Academy?
ja: アメ: あら、アポフィルアカデミーから来てるのね?

key: ...It's true that that used to be a Gym, but not anymore.
en: ...It's true that that used to be a Gym, but not anymore.
ja: ……たしかにあそこは昔ジムだったけど、今は違うわ。

key: Kiki was forced to retire due to some ongoing health concerns.
en: Kiki was forced to retire due to some ongoing health concerns.
ja: キキは、体調の問題がずっと続いていて、引退を余儀なくされたの。

key: Are you sure the stress of battling won't be too much on her?
en: Are you sure the stress of battling won't be too much on her?
ja: 戦いのストレスが、彼女には負担になりすぎたりしない?

key: ...Well, I suppose I can give you her old notes, just in case.
en: ...Well, I suppose I can give you her old notes, just in case.
ja: ……まあ、念のため、彼女の昔のノートを渡しておくわね。

key: Thanks to her school's focus on meditation, the mental energy around there is out of this world!
en: Thanks to her school's focus on meditation, the mental energy around there is out of this world!
ja: あの学校はめい想を重視してるから、あそこの精神エネルギーは常軌を逸してるわ!

key: When she uses Meditate, her Pokémon will be much, much stronger than normal, so don't give her that chance!
en: When she uses Meditate, her Pokémon will be much, much stronger than normal, so don't give her that chance!
ja: 彼女が「ヨガのポーズ」を使うと、ポケモンは普段よりずっとずっと強くなるから、そのチャンスを与えちゃダメ!

key: By the way, for beating the Fighting-type, although many people go for Flying-types, that could be a risky play.
en: By the way, for beating the Fighting-type, although many people go for Flying-types, that could be a risky play.
ja: ちなみに、かくとうタイプを倒すのに、みんなひこうタイプを選びがちだけど、それは危険な選択かもしれない。

key: With all the sand and ash down there, it's easy for it to get kicked up and vision to be lost. But Kiki's mentally focused Pokémon will often still land attacks!
en: With all the sand and ash down there, it's easy for it to get kicked up and vision to be lost. But Kiki's mentally focused Pokémon will often still land attacks!
ja: あそこは砂と灰だらけだから、簡単に舞い上がって視界を失いやすいの。でも、精神を研ぎ澄ましたキキのポケモンは、それでも攻撃を当ててくることが多いわ!

key: Rather than Flying-types, try using the mental energy against her! Psychic-types can really do a number down there!
en: Rather than Flying-types, try using the mental energy against her! Psychic-types can really do a number down there!
ja: ひこうタイプよりも、精神エネルギーで対抗してみて! あそこではエスパータイプがかなり活躍するわよ!

key: Good luck, whatever happens.
en: Good luck, whatever happens.
ja: 何があっても、頑張って。

key: I've been looking forward to coming here for so long, and yet...
en: I've been looking forward to coming here for so long, and yet...
ja: ずっとここに来るのを楽しみにしてたのに……

key: Many of the older students here say it's not what it used to be-- but it's still everything I'd imagined.
en: Many of the older students here say it's not what it used to be-- but it's still everything I'd imagined.
ja: ここの古株の生徒たちは、昔とは違うって言うけど――それでも、僕が想像していたとおりの場所だよ。

key: CAL: \PN.
en: CAL: \PN.
ja: キャル: \PN。

key: CAL: I'm glad you're here.
en: CAL: I'm glad you're here.
ja: キャル: 来てくれて助かった。

key: The truth is, I was the one who passed the report of this going on to the Nightclub.
en: The truth is, I was the one who passed the report of this going on to the Nightclub.
ja: 実を言うと、この件をナイトクラブに報告したのは俺なんだ。

key: I probably could've done a lot to stop this, but...
en: I probably could've done a lot to stop this, but...
ja: 止めるためにできたことは、たぶんいろいろあったはずなんだけど……

key: ...Well, how is she?
en: ...Well, how is she?
ja: ……それで、彼女の様子は?

key: This was another Anomaly's doing, of course.
en: This was another Anomaly's doing, of course.
ja: もちろん、これも別のアノマリーの仕業だ。

key: You just defeated it, and our star actor ran through here.
en: You just defeated it, and our star actor ran through here.
ja: お前がさっき倒したやつで、その主役がここを走り抜けていった。

key: It's currently hiding in Kiki's room.
en: It's currently hiding in Kiki's room.
ja: 今はキキ先生の部屋に隠れてる。

key: A Pokémon that can steal the feelings of others...
en: A Pokémon that can steal the feelings of others...
ja: 他人の感情を奪えるポケモン……

key: You can probably guess what it is, right?
en: You can probably guess what it is, right?
ja: もう何か、見当はついてるだろ?

key: With how much pressure she was putting on herself, when I found that thing...
en: With how much pressure she was putting on herself, when I found that thing...
ja: あの人がどれだけ自分を追い詰めてたか知ってたから、そいつを見つけたとき……

key: It was willing to help, and I thought it might just do the job.
en: It was willing to help, and I thought it might just do the job.
ja: そいつは手伝ってくれる気があったし、うまくいくかもって思ったんだ。

key: Show her that she's enough herself.
en: Show her that she's enough herself.
ja: 彼女に、そのままの自分で十分なんだって、分からせようとしたんだよ。

key: She doesn't have to keep trying to be someone else.
en: She doesn't have to keep trying to be someone else.
ja: 誰か別の誰かになろうと、頑張り続ける必要なんてないんだって。

key: ...It could've been a little nicer about it.
en: ...It could've been a little nicer about it.
ja: ……まあ、もう少しやり方があったかもしれないけどな。

key: Sorry about that.
en: Sorry about that.
ja: それは悪かったよ。

key: I'll go patch things up with Victoria. Make sure she's on the right path.
en: I'll go patch things up with Victoria. Make sure she's on the right path.
ja: ヴィクトリアとは、俺がちゃんと話をつけてくる。ちゃんとした方向に向かうようにな。

key: The Pokémon is all yours though.
en: The Pokémon is all yours though.
ja: あのポケモンは、お前に任せる。

key: Best clean it up before she tries to punch it or something...
en: Best clean it up before she tries to punch it or something...
ja: 彼女がそいつを殴りつけたりする前に、片づけといた方がいいぞ……

key: Sorry for springing this on you but your help is, as always, irreplaceable.
en: Sorry for springing this on you but your help is, as always, irreplaceable.
ja: 急にこんなことになって悪いけど、お前の助けはいつも通り、かけがえのないものだよ。

key: VICTORIA: Oh, you're done already?
en: VICTORIA: Oh, you're done already?
ja: ヴィクトリア: あら、もう終わったんですか?

key: I was just... coming to check.
en: I was just... coming to check.
ja: ちょうど……様子を見に来たところで。

key: I can't say I'm really happy about Cal setting this whole thing up...
en: I can't say I'm really happy about Cal setting this whole thing up...
ja: キャルがこんなことを仕組んだのは、正直あまり気分がよくないですけど……

key: But it's over now.
en: But it's over now.
ja: でも、もう終わったことです。

key: The students have dispersed, and no one seems to really remember what happened...
en: The students have dispersed, and no one seems to really remember what happened...
ja: 生徒たちは散り散りになって、誰も何があったか、あまり覚えていないみたい……

key: ...Which is just fine by me.
en: ...Which is just fine by me.
ja: ……それはそれで、都合がいいです。

key: If you happened to forget it too, I can't say I'd mind.
en: If you happened to forget it too, I can't say I'd mind.
ja: もしあなたも忘れてくれたなら、それはそれで構いません。

key: But... he was right.
en: But... he was right.
ja: でも……彼の言うとおりでした。

key: Maybe I did need to acknowledge that part of myself still.
en: Maybe I did need to acknowledge that part of myself still.
ja: 自分のその部分を、まだ認める必要があったのかもしれません。

key: Maybe it was... a little bit helpful.
en: Maybe it was... a little bit helpful.
ja: もしかしたら……少しは、役に立ったのかも。

key: Even if he's stupid and I hate him.
en: Even if he's stupid and I hate him.
ja: あいつがバカで、大嫌いだとしてもです。

key: I don't hate him.
en: I don't hate him.
ja: 別に、嫌いなわけじゃないですけど。

key: But I am mad at him, so don't tell him that!
en: But I am mad at him, so don't tell him that!
ja: でも腹は立ってるので、それは彼には言わないでくださいね!

key: If I'm acknowledging my feelings, he can acknowledge that he really needs to stop going behind people's backs, even if it IS for the greater good or whatever!
en: If I'm acknowledging my feelings, he can acknowledge that he really needs to stop going behind people's backs, even if it IS for the greater good or whatever!
ja: わたしが自分の気持ちを認めるなら、彼だって、たとえそれが大局的にはいいことだとしても、人の裏でこそこそ動くのはやめるべきだって認めるべきです!

key: ...Anyway, thanks for your help.
en: ...Anyway, thanks for your help.
ja: ……とにかく、手伝ってくれてありがとうございました。

key: I'm going to... take some time and keep processing this.
en: I'm going to... take some time and keep processing this.
ja: 少し時間をかけて……これを消化していこうと思います。

key: I don't need to do it like Kiki.
en: I don't need to do it like Kiki.
ja: キキ先生と同じやり方をする必要はない。

key: I just need to do it like me.
en: I just need to do it like me.
ja: わたしはわたしのやり方でやればいい。

key: That would be enough.
en: That would be enough.
ja: それで十分なはずです。

key: 'Ey kid! You want me to teach your Pokémon some special moves? Take a look what I got!
en: 'Ey kid! You want me to teach your Pokémon some special moves? Take a look what I got!
ja: よお坊主! ポケモンに特別な技を教えてほしいか? ラインナップ見てけよ!

key: What suits your fancy?
en: What suits your fancy?
ja: どれがお好みだ?

key: Gastro Acid is gonna run you a single Blue Shard.
en: Gastro Acid is gonna run you a single Blue Shard.
ja: いえきは、青いかけら1個だな。

key: Come back when you've got it.
en: Come back when you've got it.
ja: 手に入れたら、また来な。

key: Perfect.
en: Perfect.
ja: よし、来たか。

key: Recycle is gonna run you two Purple Shards.
en: Recycle is gonna run you two Purple Shards.
ja: リサイクルは、紫のかけら2個だ。

key: Endeavor is gonna run you three Green Shards.
en: Endeavor is gonna run you three Green Shards.
ja: がむしゃらは、緑のかけら3個だ。

key: Pain Split is gonna run you three Red Shards.
en: Pain Split is gonna run you three Red Shards.
ja: いたみわけは、赤のかけら3個だ。

key: Any time, kid.
en: Any time, kid.
ja: いつでも来いよ、坊主。

key: Did you know?
en: Did you know?
ja: 知ってたか?

key: The best place to train your Defense is by striking the Magcargo that bar Pyrous Mountain's lava flow!
en: The best place to train your Defense is by striking the Magcargo that bar Pyrous Mountain's lava flow!

en: Haaaaaah!
ja: はぁぁぁぁっ!
